title: Masoom
desc: A gangster, Barood, kills Vikram Singh and kidnaps his only son, Kishan. Meanwhile, an investigative journalist, Akash, tracks down Barood and tries to get him arrested and punished for his crimes.

title: Devi
desc: Devi, a snake goddess, vows to protect the daughter of the man who died while trying to save her from a powerful demon. However, she falls in love with a human, unaware of the consequences.

title: Andaaz
desc: After his sweetheart Kajal marries another man, Raj moves to Cape Town. He eventually agrees to marry Jiya but is shocked to find that she is Kajal's widowed sister-in-law.

title: Real Tevar
desc: Harsha is the idealistic scion of a self-made multimillionaire, Ravikanth. After a chance meeting with Charuseela leads him to a remote village, Harsha wishes to develop it with her help.

title: Jaanwar
desc: A criminal changes the course of his life when he decides to raise a baby who has survived a train crash, but chaos ensues when his past begins to haunt him.
